description: [Experimental web session] Get one AppMetrica web workspace: groups with headers and widgets (dashboard_widget_id, widget_id, view kind, funnel_id), enriched with the widget name, namespace, metrics and dimensions. Uses the unofficial AppMetrica web API through a headless Chrome session: run `npx appmetrica-mcp login` once to log in to Yandex.
name: web_get_workspace
